page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8t-8x.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates eight NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs, delivering a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, and the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of high-count dedicated Intel Xeon processors and eight Ada Lovelace GPUs represents a specialized hardware class designed for parallel processing workloads. The lack of local storage requires architectural planning for network-based storage latency and cost, while the high baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps helps mitigate external data transfer bottlenecks.

This hardware configuration is designed for workloads requiring massive parallel computation and high GPU memory capacity, such as deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, molecular modeling, and complex 3D rendering pipelines.
